body: Use case: stylized-concept. Production pixel-art base sprite for Chronos 'Flame / Prism Core' skin in Sky Dominators. Reference 1 is the ship design; reference 2 is only the molten sword/fire energy style. Reinterpret this exact recognizable angular aircraft as an orthographic straight TOP-DOWN arcade sprite, nose UP, exhaust DOWN, bilateral symmetry. Preserve its dark obsidian pointed cockpit and red-bronze metallic armor with branching flowing gold-orange molten seams, four prominent swept pointed blade wing tips. Crisp visible square pixel clusters, retro 8-bit-inspired high-end sprite art, limited rich black/red/orange/gold/ivory palette, no smooth painterly shading. Strong legible silhouette. Base hull glowing seams only, compact integrated flame exhaust, no huge external flare or long spikes yet; those will animate on a separate layer. Single entire centered ship, roughly 65% canvas width and 75% height, generous fully transparent margins. Genuinely transparent alpha background, no black matte or shadow, no white rounded rectangle. No text, numbers, signature, watermark or UI. This is a complete fixed hull layer for consistent 40-frame animation; no sprite grid.
effects: Production VFX layer atlas for Chronos Flame / Prism Core pixel-art spacecraft. Reference 1 fire spark is STYLE reference: orange-red flowing ribbons, ivory white hot blade cores and long swordlike pointed rays. Reference 2 ship is PALETTE reference only. Draw NO aircraft. True transparent background everywhere between effects. EXACTLY FOUR columns by THREE rows, 12 equal square cells, each fully contained with at least 10% margin, no visible grid/text. ROW ONE: four consecutive variants of elongated vertically flowing crackling red/orange/gold flame tendrils, narrow upward fire with branching molten strands and transparent negative space, similar brightness/center each cell. ROW TWO: four radial energy bursts seen top-down, same fixed center, brilliant narrow sword-like ivory/gold energy spikes flashing outward in diagonal and horizontal directions, layered red flame tendrils between spikes; vary angles and lengths gently across four frames. These are luminous under-ship overlays, not explosions/smoke. ROW THREE: four consecutive downward rocket-flame plumes, white-yellow core tapering down to gold/orange/red wisps, fixed attachment point top center, transparent margins. Crisp retro 8-bit pixel-art clusters, hard stepped edges, bright high-contrast colors, no painted gradients or blurred smoke, no background/matte, no numbers, no watermarks, no additional objects. These reusable layers will be phased into an actual 40-frame looping animation.
blackFire: Create a NEW replacement UNDER-SHIP BLACK FIRE effects atlas for Flame / Prism Core, matching the pixel-art game style and radial sword-flame silhouettes in the MIDDLE ROW of the reference only. Exactly 4 animation keyframes arranged in a precise 2 by 2 square grid on true transparent alpha background. No hull, no ordinary flame plumes, no text, no grid lines. Each frame: a radial burst of intensely BLACK FLAME tongues and long sharp swordlike black energy spikes, with curling irregular fire ribbons extending outward from the same center. This is supernatural black fire, not an orange starburst and not a smoke cloud. Palette is predominantly near-black obsidian (#08090c) and dark charcoal (#20232a), narrow subdued slate-gray highlights outlining flame tips, very sparse deep dark crimson embers (#65151a). NO white, gold, yellow or orange bright cores. Black flame must have solid visibly dark substance, surrounded by transparent negative space between tongues. Four related poses flowing gently clockwise, same fixed center and consistent extents, suitable for blended 40-frame animation. Crisp 8-bit pixel-art clusters, jagged stepped edges, no blur. Each effect fits comfortably inside its own equal square cell with 12% clear transparent margins on all sides; do not let any flame cross cell boundaries. Output only these four black-flame radial sprites, genuinely transparent background with NO black rectangular matte.
gothicHull: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit the supplied top-down pixel-art spacecraft HULL into a dark gothic theme. Keep exactly its recognizable overall silhouette, wing arrangement, proportions, nose-up orientation, central cockpit, and centered composition. Replace bright orange/gold lava plating with near-black obsidian and charcoal armor, intricately ribbed cathedral-like gothic metal panels, narrow aged silver blade edges, restrained dark crimson glowing fissures and garnet cockpit reflections. Predominantly dark armor, clearly readable through cool slate/silver highlights; no large bright orange or gold regions. Ominous elegant gothic spacecraft, not a creature. Preserve crisp visible square pixel clusters and stepped edges for a retro 8-bit arcade sprite. The same compact integrated tail exhaust may become deep crimson. No external flame aura, no extra wings, no skull objects, no text or symbols. Single whole aircraft on genuinely transparent alpha background, generous clear margins. Do not add a black rectangular matte. This replaces only the fixed hull layer underneath a separate existing animated black-fire effect.
